summary: Breeze Acquisition Corp. II filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 12,500,000 units at $10.00/unit, generating $125M gross proceeds, with partial exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment for an additional 1,500,000 units. The filing attaches standard IPO-related agreements (underwriting, rights, letter agreement). This is a routine IPO closing, not an acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC (the company itself is a SPAC, but the filing is its IPO, not a de-SPAC), management change, or other special situation. Category is None.
